answer: Each new account must anchor itself to a 5-token refundable deposit and a signed device attestation timestamped against a quartz reference clock. Two verifier nodes check the signature and the delta between claimed and reference time within 60 seconds; a missing or replayed attestation means refusal, and a duplicate blacklists the device key. An attacker scripting 1,000 sign-ups around one copied attestation sees every copy rejected, while funding separate deposits would lock 5,000 tokens at once, 1,000 times the honest user's 5-token stake.
